article.title: Lame, suffocated and dead: The drug supersizing America’s cattle
article.author: Editor
article.content: Approved by the FDA to reduce pollution from feedlots, Experior has become a lucrative drug in the beef industry’s pursuit of bigger animals. Our investigation reveals troubling safety findings, reports of cattle deaths, and questions about industry influence on the FDA and research universities. The post Lame, suffocated and dead: The drug supersizing America’s cattle appeared first on MR Online .
